response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate lacks relevant Java proficiency for the role, has only basic German language skills (a hard requirement), and holds senior-level positions inconsistent with an entry-level junior developer role, raising concerns about fit, salary expectations, and team integration.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong track record in open-source contributions and technical workshops
Demonstrated agile practices and DevOps infrastructure experience
concerns: Java experience is minimal and not primary in recent roles
German language proficiency is only basic, failing job requirement
Senior-level titles and salary expectations misalign with entry-level role
